howItWorks.heading: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: A closed-loop system that continuously improves your competency passport from first login to promotion.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Upload your role, department, and existing qualifications. The system builds a baseline competency passport.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Adaptive quizzes and scenario tests dynamically evaluate your knowledge across all mapped competency domains.
howItWorks.step3Desc: A multi-dimensional gap matrix pinpoints exactly where you stand versus the target role readiness benchmark.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Curated iGOT / NSSTA courses are ranked and served in priority order to close your specific gaps fastest.
